surface_mechanism_description: The guanidinate ligand was preferred to the amido ligand as the ligand reacting with the surface groups during the metal-precursor pulse. Both guanidinate ligands were released when the precursor molecule attached to the surface.
evidence: In the same earlier investigation, an in-situ reaction mechanistic study concluded that the guanidinate ligand was preferred to the amido ligand as the ligand reacting with the surface groups during the metal-precursor pulse. In fact, both guanidinate ligands were released when the precursor molecule attached to the surface.
